note: Unmasked Fugle quotes (#834; docs/DATA_SOURCES.md 盤中報價): the one copy of the patterns tools/ops/quote_guard.py and tools/ops/agent_guard.cjs both read. Each regex is written so Python re and JavaScript RegExp read it the same: [0-9] rather than \d, no named groups, fixed-width lookbehind only. templates: the pieces of backend/worker/intraday.py TEMPLATES that carry a Fugle value once filled in, keyed by the TEMPLATES key or the field ({open}); a masked value (<價>, <時間>) holds no digit and passes, and so do the rule levels (觸及規則進場價 X, 停損 X, 目標一 X), which are ours, a count (無成交 N, 成交 N 股／張／筆) and a daily price written 開盤價 X. fields: the fields of Fugle's answer backend/worker/fugle.py reads, as JSON keys, Python keywords or key=value, followed by a number (inside [ and { too); matched on the whole text, so pretty-printed JSON counts. message: a record of an intraday message, the --- message line --dry-run prints or a line of the day's jsonl; its decoded text is checked with the templates, so a \u-escaped one counts too. backend/tests/test_quote_guard.py binds templates to TEMPLATES.
